title: Senryaku Shougi
overview:
A completely new shogi game for anyone who wants to get stronger at shogi, letting you learn joseki (standard openings) while you play. Master every attacking and defensive strategy and aim to unify the realm.

Full-featured functions for learning joseki
You play by choosing shogi's distinctive strategies (attack and defense formations) from among dozens of programmed joseki. The win-loss record shows and saves your results for each strategy in detailed categories. By registering in the game record ledger (save data), you can resume a game (continue) at any time.

Visual effects with a difference
A fresh feature made possible by polygon graphics lets you freely change the viewpoint at any time during a game. You can also choose the board design to suit your taste. Piece movements are recreated with animations of natural moves.

Of course, other features are included too
Beautiful BGM that effectively sets the mood of the match. A move "announcement" function with a female voice. Seven difficulty levels that everyone from beginners to experts can enjoy let you play at a level matching your skill.

Test your skill in Unification Mode
Play against the champions representing 7 regions across Japan and aim to unify the realm through shogi. Your opponents are all seasoned veterans of countless battles. They make full use of a wide range of attacking and defensive strategies and attack without mercy. Master a variety of joseki and achieve your dream of conquering the whole nation.

将棋が強くなりたい人へ贈る、対局しながら「定跡」が学べるまったく新しい将棋ゲームです。攻め構えのあらゆる戦法をマスターして、天下統一を目指します。

■「定跡」を学べる充実した機能
将棋特有の戦法（攻め・構え）を、プログラムされた数十種類に及ぶ定跡の中から選択し対局をしていきます。勝敗録で戦法別の対戦成績を詳細な項目で表示・セーブできます。棋譜台帳（セーブデータ）への登録で、いつでも指し継ぎ（続き）をすることができます。

■ひと味違うビジュアル効果
ポリゴン画像処理が可能にした、対局中の視点をいつでも自由自在に変えられる新鮮な機能。盤のデザインも好みに合わせて選択できます。駒の移動も自然な指し方のアニメーションで再現しています。

■その他の機能ももちろん搭載
対戦を効果的に演出する美しいＢＧＭ。女性の声による指し手“読み上げ”機能。初心者から上級者まで幅広く楽しめる７段階のレベル設定で実力に合わせての対局が可能です。

■天下統一モードで腕試し
日本全国の７地域を代表する強豪たちと対局して、将棋での天下統一を目指します。相手は百戦錬磨の強者ばかり。攻めも構えも多彩な戦法を駆使して、容赦なく攻めてきます。いろいろな定跡をマスターして、夢の全国制覇を達成してください。
